articles.summary: HONG KONG, March 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Futu Holdings Limited (“Futu” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: FUTU), a leading tech-driven online brokerage and wealth management platform, today announced its unaudited financial results for the fourth quarter and full year ended December 31, 2025.
articles.title: Futu Announces Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Unaudited Financial Results
